quote: Carl Ludwig Siegel conjectured in 1964 that e^−1/2, or about 60.65%, of all prime numbers are regular, in the asymptotic sense of natural density.
note: The conjecture about infinitely many regular primes and their conjectured density of e^-1/2 is attributed to Siegel's work in 1964. The definition of regular primes themselves was introduced by Ernst Kummer in 1850, but Siegel's 1964 work posed the density conjecture that forms part of the modern statement of this problem.
